question: What is the keyboard shortcut to remove paragraph indentation in MS Word 365?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + Shift + M**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The keyboard shortcut **Ctrl + Shift + M** is used in MS Word 365 to decrease or remove paragraph indentation.
 
• This command specifically reduces the left indentation of a paragraph by 0.5 inches (default setting).
 
• It is particularly useful for formatting documents quickly and efficiently, especially in professional or academic writing.
 
• Users can repeatedly press **Ctrl + Shift + M** to completely remove multiple levels of indentation, if applied.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paragraph Indentation**

 
 
• Paragraph indentation refers to the space added to the left margin of a paragraph.
 
• It helps in visually distinguishing sections of text, improving document readability.
 
 
 
• **MS Word Keyboard Shortcuts**
 
 
• **Ctrl + M:** Increases paragraph indentation by 0.5 inches.
 
• **Ctrl + Shift + T:** Reduces hanging indentation in a paragraph.
 
• **Ctrl + T:** Increases hanging indentation of a paragraph.
 
 
 
• **Formatting Options in MS Word**
 
 
• MS Word provides a "Paragraph" section in the "Home" tab for adjusting indentation and spacing.
 
• Users can also access advanced options via the "Paragraph" dialog box for precise control.
 
 
 
• **Customizing Shortcuts**
 
 
• Users can customize keyboard shortcuts in MS Word by navigating to File > Options > Customize Ribbon > Keyboard Shortcuts.
 
• This allows assigning new shortcuts for frequently used commands, enhancing productivity.
